definitions.explanation: Secretly planning with others to commit an illegal or harmful act. A legal term that became widely known through political debate over the '{共謀罪|きょうぼうざい}' (conspiracy law) in Japan.

examples.japanese: {共謀|きょうぼう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{及|およ}んだ→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧。
examples.english: They conspired and committed the crime.

examples.japanese: {共謀罪|きょうぼうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めぐる⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Debate over the conspiracy law took place in the Diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共謀|きょうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The two were arrested on suspicion of conspiracy.

notes: Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {共謀|きょうぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to conspire). The term gained wide public attention through debates over Japan's {共謀罪|きょうぼうざい} (conspiracy crime) legislation, formally part of the {組織的犯罪処罰法|そしきてきはんざいしょばつほう} (Act on Punishment of Organized Crimes). Common collocations: {共謀|きょうぼう}{共同正犯|きょうどうせいはん} (co-conspiracy), {共謀|きょうぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧ (suspicion of conspiracy). Related: ⟦{陰謀|いんぼう}→陰謀：10887_inbou⟧ (plot, secret scheme) is broader and can refer to political intrigue, not just criminal conspiracy.
